Another Century's Episode R.name: Another Century's Episode: R
Another Century's Episode R.summary: Another Century's Episode: R, abbreviated as A.C.E.: R, is a mecha action video game developed by FromSoftware and Banpresto and published by Bandai Namco Games.

Heavy Fire - Afghanistan.name: Heavy Fire: Afghanistan
Heavy Fire - Afghanistan.summary: Heavy Fire: Afghanistan is a super fast playing on-rails shooter set in modern-day Afghanistan featuring tanks, assault vehicles and helicopters. The game offers 60 awards, one machine co-op for up to four, Steam Cloud, Leaderboards and Trading Cards.

Heavy Rain - Director's Cut.name: Heavy Rain: Director's Cut
Heavy Rain - Director's Cut.summary: Heavy Rain: Director's Cut was released as a "complete" version of the game which includes the only piece of downloadable content, The Taxidermist, as well as the game soundtrack, Playstation Move support, eight making-of videos, three dynamic themes, fifteen pieces of concept art, and two bonus trailers. The game is also marked as a Playstation Greatest Hits title, bearing the red box.

Madden NFL 25.name: Madden NFL 25
Madden NFL 25.summary: Madden NFL 25 celebrates 25 years of Madden NFL Football action with Physics You Can Feel from the most authentic NFL game franchise on Earth. EA Sports - It's In The Game.

NieR Replicant.name: Nier Replicant
NieR Replicant.summary: NieR RepliCant is a Japanese PS3 version of NieR Gestalt with a younger main character. Both games are based in the same world, but differ only in the lead character's design, relationship with the character of Yonah, and the time in which the game takes place.

Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009.name: Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009
Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009.summary: Rapala Fishing Frenzy 2009 is a fishing sports game where players travel to popular freshwater fishing locations and compete in tournaments. The gameplay focuses on casting, reeling, and fighting fish to catch trophy species and perform well under tournament conditions.The game includes multiple modes and locations, with different challenges that emphasize skill-based fishing and trying to land a wide variety of catches.
